L159: ## Introduction
L160: 
L161: Hey everyone, and welcome to Method's guide for the Excavation Site: Wetlands Dungeon in World of Warcraft: Forever. In this guide we’ll be going over all trash, bosses, loot, and quests for this dungeon.

L187: ## Excavation Site: Wetlands Video Guide
L188: 
L189: 【47†YouTube video player†www.youtube-nocookie.com】
L190: ## Excavation Site: Wetlands Location
L191: 
L192: Excavation Site: Wetlands is located in the Wetlands, a site overtaken by crocolisks, raptors, the Dragonmaw Orc Clan, and massive spiders!
L193: 
L194: Alliance players will have no trouble getting here from either Thelsemar or Menethil Harbor. Horde players don’t have to stress too much, as they will only have a slightly longer trek from Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
L195: 
L196: 【48†Image: Excavation Site: Wetlands Location】【49†Image: Excavation Site: Wetlands Dungeon Portal】
L197: The Dungeon Entrance is located near the Dun Algaz entrance, where you'll see the Meeting Stone for it at the base of the mountain you'll scale to get up there.
L198: ## Excavation Site: Wetlands Dungeon Quests
L199: 
L200: There are a handful of quests for this dungeon. Alliance will have a couple of quests unlocked through chain quests in the Wetlands, whereas Horde players will need to pick up theirs from around Azeroth.
L201: 
L202:   * 【50†ALLIANCE】
L203:   * 【51†HORDE】

L205: 【52†Songblade Search†www.wowhead.com】  | 24  | 6,150  | Picked up from Dorin Songblade in Lakeshire, Redridge Mountains.
L206: 【53†Lost in the Thicket Things†www.wowhead.com】  | 24  | 4,900  | Picked up from Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor, Wetlands. Breadcrumb 【54†Seeking Caitlin†www.wowhead.com】 can be picked up in Astrannar, Ashenvale, from Llana.
L207: 【55†Highland Hides†www.wowhead.com】  | 24  | 1,150  | Picked up from James Halloran in Menethil Harbor, Wetlands.
L208: Must complete 【56†Young Crocolisk Skins†www.wowhead.com】 first.
L209: 【57†Horrors in the Highland†www.wowhead.com】  | 24  | 6,150  | Picked up from the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
L210: Must complete The Greendwarden quest chain starting with 【58†The Greenwarden†www.wowhead.com】 first.

L228: ## Excavation Site: Wetlands Important Trash
L229: 
L230: There are a few noteworthy trash mobs we want to go over in this raid, particularly in the raptor area as the raptors are incredibly powerful in terms of raw damage.
L231: ### Young Riptooth
L232: 
L233:   * These mobs come in packs of three and will deal 【66†Fatal Bite†www.wowhead.com】 to their target.
L234:   * Focus them down 1 by 1 rather than using full AoE so your tank and healer don't get overwhelmed.
L235: 
L236: 【67†Image】
L237: 
L238: ### Marsh Skulkers and Elder Crocolisk
L239: 
L240:   * Skulkers will cast a 【68†Musclet Rot†www.wowhead.com】, stat reducing the target's Spirit and Stamina.
L241:   * Both mobs will cast 【69†Tendon Rip†www.wowhead.com】, slowing the target by 71%.
L242: 
L243: 【70†Image】
L244: ### Thicket Hunter and Thicket Matriarch
L245: 
L246:   * Ticket Hunters will hit their targets with 【71†Infected Wound,†www.wowhead.com】 a disease that increases physical damage. Cleanse this.
L247:   * Thicket Matriarchs will hit their targets with 【72†Rend Flesh†www.wowhead.com】, a powerful physical DoT.
L248: 
L249: 【73†Image】
L250: ### Thicket Lurker and Thicket Stalker
L251: 
L252:   * These mobs come in packs of 3 and will hide in the tall grass, invisible until you aggro them.
L253:   * Lurkers apply 【72†Rend Flesh†www.wowhead.com】 to their target. Be careful when getting near the grass!
L254: 
L255: 【74†Image】
L256: ### Dragonmaw Saboteur and Dragonmaw Warder
L257: 
L258:   * Saboteurs will throw bombs at a target area, and can be avoided once you see where they channel the throw.
L259:   * Warders will apply 【75†Mortal Strike†www.wowhead.com】 to their target, reducing healing effects by 50% to that target.
L260:   * Warders will also 【76†Net†www.wowhead.com】 the target, rooting them in place for 10 seconds. This can be broken by a Paladin's 【77†Blessing of Freedom†www.wowhead.com】.
L261: 
L262: 【78†Image】
L263: ### Dragonmaw Thaumaturgist
L264: 
L265:   * These mobs will cast 【79†Immolate†www.wowhead.com】 and 【80†Curse of Weakness†www.wowhead.com】 at their target.
L266:   * Accompanied by a fire elemental, take down the elemental first, and then the Thaumaturgist.
L267: 
L268: 【81†Image】
L269: ### Highland Lurker and Highland Spider
L270: 
L271:   * Lurkers will 【82†Poison†www.wowhead.com】 their target and apply 【83†Highland Venom†www.wowhead.com】 as well.
L272:   * Highland Spiders are non-elites that come in packs of 3 and will 【82†Poison†www.wowhead.com】 their targets.
L273:   * Cleanse the disease and poison ASAP!
L274: 
L275: 【84†Image】
L276: ## Excavation Site: Wetlands Bosses
L277: 
L278: There are 4 Bosses in Excavation Site: Wetlands, but only 3 that drop loot. Highland Horror is a quest boss for Alliance.
L279: 
L280:   * 【85†Saltspine】
L281:   * 【86†Shadetooth】
L282:   * 【87†Highland Horror】
L283:   * 【88†Relic Guardian】
L284: ### Saltspine
L285: 
L286: Saltspine is the first boss of Excavation Wetlands and his primary ability is 【89†Dust Storm†www.wowhead.com】, which will greatly reduce the threat generation of the tank.
L287: 
L288: Saltspine will also cast 【90†Fatal Bite†www.wowhead.com】 and 【69†Tendon Rip†www.wowhead.com】 on the target. This boss patrols the edge of the crocolisk lake area.
L289: 
L290: Be careful when pulling the boss with other mobs, as it may be too much for your tank and healer.
L291: 
L292: 【91†Image】
L293: ### Shadetooth
L294: 
L295: Shadetooth is the second boss of the dungeon and patrols the entirety of the raptor pathway. He deals intense damage and is accompanied by two Thicket Hunters.
L296: His main mechanic is his fear: 【92†Terrifying Roar,†www.wowhead.com】 as it can fear you into hidden packs hidden in the tall grass. You'll want a Shaman's 【93†Tremor Totem†www.wowhead.com】 or a Priests 【94†Fear Ward†www.wowhead.com】 on your tank here. If you have neither, you will want to clear out the trash hidden in the grass before pulling this boss.
L297: He’ll also apply a powerful 【95†Rend†www.wowhead.com】 to the tank, dealing 77 physical damage every 3 seconds, and will 【96†Enrage†www.wowhead.com】 at 20%. Increasing attack speed by 30% and physical damage by 15.
L298: 
L299: 【97†Image】
L300: ### Highland Horror
L301: 
L302: Highland Horror is a quest boss for Alliance only and does not drop any loot.
L303: 
L304: He has two abilities: 【98†Entangling Roots†www.wowhead.com】 and 【99†Wild Regeneration†www.wowhead.com】.
L305: 
L306: The only real concern with this boss is accidentally pulling the slimes that surround him. Outside of that, take him down fast and collect your quest item.
L307: 
L308: 【100†Image】
L309: ### Relic Guardian
L310: 
L311: Relic Guardian is the final boss of the dungeon and jumps to level 31!
L312: 
L313: Relic Guardian needs to be activated from a Titan Control Panel located by him. Because he’s a higher level, targets will have a higher chance of misses and dodges, making threat potentially a little slippery.
L314: Relic Guardian casts 【101†Thunderclap†www.wowhead.com】, which reduces everyone's attack speed around him. He also has a frontal cleave with 【102†Arcing Smash†www.wowhead.com】, so tanks need to face him away from the rest of the group.
L315: 
L316: He’ll do an individual 【103†Knockaway†www.wowhead.com】 that reduces threat, and an AoE knockback and stun through 【104†War Stomp†www.wowhead.com】. All ranged should make sure to not be near the boss to avoid this mechanic.
L317: Tip: This boss can be stunned and slowed, so you can actually kite the boss if he becomes too overwhelming, if you have slows like a Hunter's 【105†Concussive Shot†www.wowhead.com】 or a Shaman's 【106†Earthbind Totem†www.wowhead.com】.
L318: 
L319: 【107†Image】
